edges.edge: Variables store values of primitive types
Operators manipulate values stored in variables
Expressions combine operators and variables
Evaluation determines the result of expressions
Statements use evaluated expressions for actions
Control structures manage statement execution flow
Comments document code alongside control structures
Subprograms organize code beyond simple statements
Methods are subprograms within classes
Parameter passing supplies data to methods
Overloading allows multiple methods with same name
Execution stack manages method calls and returns
Recursion uses the execution stack for self calls
Exception handling manages runtime errors in recursion
Classes define blueprints for object oriented programming
Objects are instances created from classes
Instantiation is the process of creating objects
Members are fields and methods within objects
Constructors initialize members during instantiation
Initialization sets initial state via constructors
Access control restricts visibility of members
Encapsulation hides internal state using access control
Abstraction simplifies complexity through encapsulation
Inheritance allows classes to derive from others
Inclusion polymorphism treats subclasses as superclasses
Overriding redefines inherited methods in subclasses
Static binding resolves method calls at compile time
Dynamic binding resolves method calls at runtime
Static types are declared types known at compile time
Dynamic types are actual object types at runtime
Abstract types define interfaces without implementation
Comparing objects checks equality between instances
Cloning objects creates copies of instances
Arrays store collections of same type objects
Enumerations define fixed sets of named constants
Generic programming allows type parameterization
Scope defines region where variables are valid
Visibility determines access to scoped elements
Memory management handles allocation for visible objects
Garbage collection reclaims unused memory automatically
Name spaces organize classes to avoid naming conflicts
Compilation units are files containing name spaces
Nesting types define classes within other classes
Multithreading allows concurrent execution of nesting types
Synchronization issues manage access in multithreading
Virtual machine executes code handling synchronization
Class loading brings classes into virtual machine
JIT compilation optimizes code during class loading
Data structures utilize JIT compiled standard libraries
Java Streams process data structures efficiently
Java GUI builds interfaces using streams and structures
